audit_findings_measured: F1 · DEAD WIRE: fill-ledger-cron.yml — 0 runs EVER (GitHub API total_count=0) despite its :17/:47 cron committed since CR-0042; the fill-ledger book survived only because sibling desks wrote it. ANSWER: keeper arc watches it (45m gap law) + live PAT dispatch proves the workflow itself executes.

F2 · SCHEDULER STARVATION PATTERN CONFIRMED REPO-WIDE on young crons: sovereign-tick-cron, earn-audit-cron, fleet-census-cron, market-grid-cron = 0 scheduled events ever (event=schedule filter), while old crons (moment-watch 642 runs, web-publish 872) fire fine — GitHub registers new cron entries and does not execute them on this repo (Z-70's measurement now a pattern). ANSWER: the keeper IS the scheduler-of-record for the arc desks until GitHub heals.

F3 · DYING DAILY DESK: self-audience failed its last 3 scheduled runs at the commit step — root cause read from run 37144830642's log: unstaged measure-step leftovers blocked 'git pull --rebase', the '|| true' swallowed it, and the push raced remote-move and failed; 9 files / 3181 insertions of daily receipts died at push, repeatedly. ANSWER: git add -A + rebase.autoStash + 3-attempt retry (house idiom), fail-loud after 3.

F4 · SILENT WATCHDOG (double defect): twin-audit's alarm gate was inline bash with node -e JS containing BACKTICKS — bash executed them as command substitution ('syntax error near unexpected token done', exit 2) on its first scheduled fire; AND the gate had been firing on a FALSE premise — twin-audit.mjs demanded the domainMarker evidence on the CONSOLE side too (ev.domainMarker || ev.aMarker), punishing a correctly-differentiated pair. Two defects cancelled into total silence: the alarm could never fire, and had it fired it would have been wrong. ANSWER: agents/twin-marker-law.cjs (marker-side law, E42 matrix) + agents/twin-issue-gate.cjs (Node desk: no quoting tricks, corrupt marker fails loud, both-token fallback honest) wired into the workflow; live re-run measures evidenceOk=true / gateFired=false on the real state.

F5 · ANONYMOUS FEE DRIFT (cross-layer C1, open since R14): kernel FEE_BPS=30 vs SAOSExchange FEE_BPS=20 had no registered arbitration. ANSWER: agents/fee-doctrine.json (the per-venue book + price-each-venue-by-its-own-doctrine rule) + agents/fee-doctrine-law.cjs (pure): governed pricing = PASS-ARBITRATED, missing/lying book = DRIFT. Cross-layer now 7 checks / 6 PASS / 1 PASS-ARBITRATED / 0 DRIFT / 0 FAIL.

F6 · PROOF-SURFACE STALENESS: public/pulse.json truth showed a 2026-10-02 snapshot while fresh day-books were committed every 30 minutes. ANSWER: THE PUBLIC TRUTH SCOPE LAW — truth.day joins the page from the fill-ledger's last committed walk, scope-labeled (DAY since 00:00Z), measuredAt stamped; a day number never laundered into lifetime, a lifetime number never hides a day.

F7 · THE OWNER'S COMPLAINT ANSWERED: 'nothing truly meaningful that can be proven' → agents/owner-proof.cjs composes THE ONE PROVABLE PAGE (owner-proof.json/.md, HEBREW surface): what we own (per-chain, chain-verifiable), the powerdown runway (475.88 SP/wk, 1903.5 SP remaining, 28 days, next 2026-10-10T02:01:27), the honest P&L (lifetime -1.12 SBD, today -0.227, content measured-dead — losses printed, not hidden), the autonomy map (48/43 workflows, 9-desk arc, STASIS clean), and the laws (claims 0 offenders, census 16/16). Every number carries {source, measuredAt}.

F8 · KEEPER PURITY + WIDENING: keeperDecide now judges the PASSED arc (true purity; empty arc = never-born fleet view), the registry widens 3→9 desks with per-desk staleness AND per-desk cooldown (daily desks retried every 4h, not stormed every 20m).
